These direct deductions are logically valid, with no finite experiment purporting to prove an infinite assertion. The primary abstract publicly confirms the strict H_d chain and K4 property; Section 7.2/Proposition 7.7 of Wang were quoted in the frozen scientific package but could not be independently reread in full.

originality.rationale: FAIL decisively by mathematical implication, not by inaccessible literature: Wang already proves the nested and strictly decreasing sequence H_1 ⊃ H_2 ⊃ ... (explicit in primary abstract) with K4 positive; the Gao--Jackson--Krohne--Seward K3 obstruction and Borel nonbipartite criterion supply endpoints. For each D, strictness itself yields a finite H in H_D\H_{D+1}; nestedness forces profile exactly {2,...,D}, and that H is nonbipartite by Borel necessity. Hence all three profile possibilities and nonbipartite realization are immediate corollaries of stronger published results, regardless of whether source uses the term dimension profile. Wang's cited M_{D,L} witnesses make the original presentation even more explicit; renaming the deduction is not a new classification.
residual_risks: The full Wang article could not be reread; residual source-verification risk does not alter that the submission explicitly assumes the stronger prior facts and derives only their corollary.
